sources.title: Manage your UK Emissions Trading Scheme reporting - ETS Gateway
facts: The ETS Gateway is the reporting service used by operators, regulators and verifiers for UK ETS and related reporting workflows.
A reporting-service workflow or account state is administrative evidence and is not itself an observed parcel greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply
facts: Aircraft operators monitor scheme-year emissions and submit verified annual emissions reports under UK ETS requirements.
Aviation operator emissions and registry records are not land-parcel greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for maritime: how to comply
facts: The first maritime UK ETS scheme year runs from 1 July to 31 December 2026 and covers specified maritime greenhouse gases.
Maritime monitoring plans, ship emissions and surrender obligations are not parcel-level emissions evidence.

sources.title: Merchant Shipping MRV carbon dioxide emissions revocation regulations 2026
facts: The 2026 instrument revokes the previous UK maritime MRV instruments as UK ETS maritime arrangements replace that regime.
Revoked or transitional reporting rules must not be treated as current measurement contracts after supersession.

sources.title: UK ETS Activity level report template
facts: The activity-level report template was updated on 20 February 2026 after a formula error was corrected.
Activity-level data used for allocation must remain distinct from verified physical emissions and parcel measurements.

sources.title: UK ETS Verification report template
facts: The template is used for verification of operators' activity-level reports.
A verification template establishes reporting procedure, not an observed emissions quantity.

sources.title: UK ETS 2025 Baseline Data Collection and HSE USE scheme status guidance
facts: The guidance links baseline-data, free-allocation and HSE/USE application requirements and was updated for the second free-allocation application stage.
Baseline and eligibility submissions are scheme inputs and must not be promoted to current parcel emissions.

sources.title: Environment Agency greenhouse gas emissions charging scheme 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027
facts: The charging scheme defines regulatory charges for installations, aviation, maritime and registry functions.
A regulatory charge or fee is administrative evidence and not an emissions measurement.

sources.title: Environment Agency greenhouse gas emissions charge tables 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2027
facts: The charge tables list monetary charges and distinguish regulatory activity from registry administration.
Charge amounts and subsistence categories cannot be used as proxies for physical greenhouse-gas emissions.

sources.title: Environmental taxes reliefs and schemes for businesses - UK ETS
facts: The GOV.UK business guidance summarises allowance surrender and verified annual reporting obligations under UK ETS.
Allowance obligations are compliance quantities and require their own scope; they are not parcel measurements.

sources.title: Voluntary monitoring reporting and verification period for waste incineration publication
facts: The Environment Agency publication prepares eligible waste operators for the voluntary MRV-only period beginning in 2026.
Voluntary participation status does not prove a reported emissions value for an installation or parcel.

sources.title: Withdrawn MIN 669 Amendment 1 reporting emissions data into UK MRV regime
facts: The page is withdrawn and records the transition away from the previous maritime MRV regime when UK ETS maritime arrangements came into force.
Withdrawn guidance is preserved only as historical transition evidence and must not override current UK ETS maritime guidance.

sources.title: NAEI Emission factors overview
facts: NAEI explains the general inventory relationship Emission = Factor x Activity and the role of representative emission factors.
An emission factor without supported activity data and scope is not an observed parcel emission.

sources.title: NAEI Emissions Factors Data Selector
facts: The NAEI selector exposes UK emission factors with source, fuel, pollutant, sector and year dimensions.
Missing factors can reflect methodology or confidentiality and must not be silently imputed.

sources.title: NAEI Maps
facts: NAEI maps include gridded greenhouse-gas data, local-authority totals and point-source information where available.
A grid cell, local-authority total or point-source coordinate is not automatically a canonical parcel binding.

sources.title: NAEI Emission Factors for Transport
facts: The transport factor page lists 2026-published fleet-weighted and road-transport emission-factor products.
Transport factors describe modeled activity relationships and are not direct parcel greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: NAEI Making projections - Greenhouse Gases
facts: NAEI describes greenhouse-gas projections as future estimates based on assumptions about activity and emission factors.
Projected emissions must remain explicitly distinct from historical or observed emissions.

sources.title: NAEI Local Authority Land Use Land Use Change and Forestry Data
facts: The page provides local-authority LULUCF emissions and removals datasets and GIS downloads with gas and CO2e dimensions.
Local-authority or per-km2 LULUCF values cannot be assigned to an individual parcel without a separate verified spatial binding method.

sources.title: NAEI UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990 to 2024 annual report webpage
facts: The NAEI report page identifies the UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory 1990 to 2024 annual report and supporting files.
National inventory evidence is authoritative for its published scope but is not a parcel-level measurement by itself.

sources.title: NAEI Road Transport Emission Factors 2024 NAEI guidance note
facts: The 2026 guidance note explains road-transport factor derivation from the 2024 NAEI and fleet/activity assumptions.
Modeled transport factors and vehicle-kilometre denominators do not identify emissions for a land parcel.

sources.title: NAEI Data Archive
facts: The archive retains older inventory and road-transport factor products and explicitly notes that older versions may be superseded or not directly comparable.
Archived factors must not supersede a newer applicable version without a documented reason.

sources.title: Environment Agency consultation on Drax Power carbon capture permit draft decision
facts: The Environment Agency consultation concerns a proposed environmental-permit variation associated with carbon capture at Drax Power.
A permit consultation or proposed capture project is not proof of achieved emissions reduction or a parcel measurement.

sources.title: UK ETS offshore installations location codes
facts: The list supports the maritime UK ETS definition of relevant offshore installations with assigned UN/LOCODEs.
A scope/location code establishes regulatory geography and does not itself establish an emissions quantity.

sources.title: Technical and operational amendments to the UK ETS Authority consultation response
facts: The UK ETS Authority response covers technical and operational proposals including registry information and ultra-small-emitter status applications.
Policy and disclosure rules are not direct physical emissions observations and must be checked against later scheme updates before use.
